name: cortex-plugin-approval-workflow
description: Human-in-the-Loop Approval — pauses agent execution at critical decision points and routes to a human reviewer via Slack/Discord/Web UI with diff previews and one-click approve/deny
author: CortexPrism

tools.name: approval_request
tools.description: Create an approval request for a pending action. Pauses execution and routes to human reviewers with diff previews.

params.name: details
params.description: Diff, command, or change details to review

params.name: risk_level
params.description: Severity of the action being approved

params.name: timeout_minutes
params.description: Minutes before the request auto-denies (overrides default)

params.name: auto_deny_on_timeout
params.description: Whether to auto-deny when the timeout expires

tools.name: approval_check
tools.description: Check the status of an approval request by its ID

params.name: request_id
params.description: The ID of the approval request to check

tools.name: approval_list
tools.description: List approval requests filtered by status

params.name: status
params.description: Filter by status: pending, approved, denied, or all

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of requests to return (default 20)

params.name: request_id
params.description: The ID of the approval request to cancel

tools.name: approval_policy
tools.description: View or update the approval policy rules that determine which actions require approval

params.name: action
params.description: Whether to view or update the policy rules

params.name: rules
params.description: JSON array of rule objects (required when action is 'update')

params.name: since
params.description: ISO date filter — only include requests created after this date

fields.label: Default Timeout (minutes)
fields.description: Minutes before a pending request times out

fields.label: Auto-Deny on Timeout
fields.description: Automatically deny requests when the timeout expires

fields.label: Require Approval For
fields.description: Minimum risk level that requires human approval

fields.label: Slack Webhook URL
fields.description: Send approval notifications to this Slack webhook

fields.label: Discord Webhook URL
fields.description: Send approval notifications to this Discord webhook
